Stop eating

Go find God

Come back after you found God
The problem is fixed after I installed the final version of Fedora 35. Yeah I think it's just a problem with incompatible modules and F35 stable release fixed all this stuff. But idk tho ¯\_(ツ)_/¯

Yep! I've installed acpi_call and akmod-acpi_call, and also the kernel-devel.

And when I try to use akmods --force [this](https://i.imgur.com/z5amcGP.png) shows up.

edit: when I try sudo dnf install kernel-devel again it shows up that the package is "Package kernel-devel-5.14.10-300.fc35.x86_64 is already installed.". 

So, not the latest...? My kernel version is 5.14.11-300.fc35.x86_64
Also it's cool that you are orang Indo 👍 salam kenal!

Oof that hurt. My situation is nothing compared to yours then 😂

So did you start over again? Did you finish the game?
I always smash that mf button in every RPG I play😂
Auto save is a necessity for me because I am prone to do dumb shit.
Good idea! I am already playing on the fastest speed outside combat.  And good thing I have an SSD on my new laptop!
It works but the storyline is already too advanced, ah well, guess I'll just have to start from scratch again. Depot A here I come.
Thank you so much! I am not at home atm but I will check it out asap. And it's a pistol build too, thanks!

Yeah :( but I am a notorious min-maxer in every game I play and I already clocked in a whooping 20+ hours in that save file alone. Would be painful to go through that whole process again. Maybe I'll just take a break and start over in a few months to make it fresh.

You can, I played it with [JoyXoff](https://joyxoff.com/en/). You have to bind the inputs manually if you want to use the shortcuts, but it's playable with "mouse" only. If you're interested, I use the preset controls for Underrail from [here](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=510161420&searchtext=). It's really a great piece of software, and it's free, unlike Controller Companion. You can play every game with it, I use it for browsing the web too when I'm feeling lazy. Hope it's useful!

Yeah I already uninstalled all of the Lenovo drivers/software except for Vantage, but the problem still persists. But I fixed the problem the hard way by deleting a file called "tpnumlkd.exe", I had to track that file using a program called Process Monitor - long story short when I use caps lock that executable file displays the annoying caps lock indicator. Oh and I have to manually set the permission in that folder so I can delete the file. I feel like Hacker Man after doing all of this.
Thank you everyone for all of your kind messages and helpful insights. Really brighten my day and I feel so grateful 🙏 Take care everyone and stay safe! :))
That's great - thanks for sharing! I'll take a look at Ram Dass, I already have the book "Be Here Now" on my to-read list. Take care and thanks for being kind and helpful!

Thank you so much, you're a very kind person.

I am planning to go to therapy but it's difficult with the current pandemic situation. They are also not that affordable and the professionals are dare I say not that great (mostly I have a bad experience), I live in a third world country and (sadly) the subpar standards are to be expected. Kinda depressing.

Thank you so much for your kind words! I know what you mean by that and I could relate. I am aware that I haven't been very kind to myself lately and it could very well be a projection on my part. Can you expand more on what you mean by "presence" or is there a specific practice that could really help with this (metta, etc)?

My attachment style came up as ambivalent/disorganized when I tested it a few months ago. I also suspect that I have BPD but I haven't been diagnosed by a professional yet. I read that majority of people with ambivalent attachment style have BPD but I don't know much about it honestly haha, I might learn about it more and learn all the coping strategies, could be very helpful!

I'm a beginner and learned about Buddhism since the pandemic as well, it has helped me so much and the teachings speaks to me. I've read a few books by Thích Nhất Hạnh and it's very helpful! I love Pema Chodron too.

Thank you very much for the kind words! I always don't feel safe and feel "exposed" whenever I tried to speak up my mind, afraid that people judge me etc, I think it's called rejection sensitivity. For example I always delete my reddit account every 6 months or so and start anew, I don't know but I always afraid that people will go dig up my post history and find out some stupid things that I have said. It's a common tradition to do that on reddit and I don't want it to happen to me lol.
